zh-CN.title: 媒体位置入口更克制
items: 图片和视频全屏预览中的位置入口移除卡片背景与醒目的独立箭头
地址、坐标和地图来源保持清晰，点击文字区域仍可进入地图

en.title: A quieter media location entry
items: The location entry in fullscreen photo and video previews no longer uses a card background or prominent standalone arrow
Address, coordinates, and map attribution stay readable, and the text area still opens the map
